subject: Security next steps + pen test report & scan cadence — CardioWorks
messages:
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@cardioworks.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap from today's demo + security asks

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team found the latency and cost controls compelling. We discussed a few security items at the end and I wanted to capture them so we can keep momentum. Action items I took away: 

- CardioWorks needs: SOC 2 status, GDPR data handling summary, and HIPAA applicability note (we're in clinical pilot, likely HIPAA scope).
- We need a vendor security questionnaire intake (I attached our standard questionnaire PDF).
- We'd like to see a recent pen test report or a redacted executive summary and a description of your vulnerability disclosure SLA and scanning cadence.

Can you confirm what you can share publicly vs. under NDA, and an estimated timeline for the items above? We are working toward an internal security review next Wednesday (9/15).

Thanks,
Alex
Director of IT Security
CardioWorks

Attachment: cardioworks_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (incoming)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@cardioworks.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today's demo + security asks

Hi Alex — great speaking with you and congrats on the pilot. See answers below and next steps from our side.

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for the hosting service in May 2027. We can share the cover letter and control summary under an NDA; full report is available to customers after an executed NDA (typical turnaround 2 business days once legal review completes).

2) GDPR/HIPAA: We will provide a short data processing addendum and a one-page GDPR dataflow summary. For HIPAA: Redwood offers a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for customers processing PHI; we can confirm scope for your pilot once you share the expected data categories.

3) Pen test: We can provide a redacted pen test executive summary and a list of remediation SLAs. We ran a third-party pen test (August 2027) — high-level findings are shareable; vendor will not allow raw evidence without an NDA.

4) Vulnerability management: Proposed standard cadence — authenticated scans weekly for critical endpoints, full external scans monthly, dependency/OSS scanning weekly. For critical CVEs we target an SLA of 72 hours to triage and 14 days to remediate or provide compensating controls, depending on severity and exploitability. We can align timelines to what you need for the review.

Next steps from Redwood: Jordan will send the redacted pen test summary and a draft vendor intake response for your questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. Ben will surface the SOC 2 cover letter and contact info for our compliance manager. If required we'll execute an NDA before handing over full artifacts.

If you need a formal statement for the pilot by 9/15, tell us and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@cardioworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today's demo + security asks

Alex — attaching the redacted pen test executive summary and a preliminary set of answers to the questionnaire you attached. See highlights below and inline notes in the attachment.

Highlights: 
- Pen test (Aug 2027) uncovered two medium findings (one outdated library, one misconfigured S3 ACL). Both were patched and verified by the vendor as of 8/29; evidence is available under NDA.
- No critical or exploitable RCEs were found.
- We run continuous dependency scanning (weekly) and external vulner scans monthly; internal prod scans are run every 2 weeks.

Proposed SLA language for your questionnaire: 72-hour triage for critical/high, 14-day remediation commitment for critical (exceptions documented), 30-day median for medium. We are happy to align stricter timelines for pilot-critical elements.

Attachments in this message: pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf; cardioworks_questionnaire_answers_draft.pdf

—Jordan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf (redacted executive summary), cardioworks_questionnaire_answers_draft.pdf (draft answers)

Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today's demo + security asks

Marissa/Jordan — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifying Qs from our security reviewer: 

- For the 72-hour triage SLA, can you confirm timezone and business-day definition (we operate Mon-Fri ET).
- For dependency scanning, do you have a public dashboard or API we can poll for scan status? If not, would you provide weekly scan summaries during the pilot?
- For HIPAA/BAA: we will share a short list of PHI categories by Monday; will you need a signed MSA + BAA to share the full pen test evidence?

Also looping in Jeff Moran from our security consultancy (jmoran@securityconsult.com) who may want to hop on a 30-min call next week to go over remediation timelines. Are you available Tues 9/14 or Wed 9/15?

Thanks,
Alex

Cc: Jeff Moran <jmoran@securityconsult.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today's demo + security asks

Alex / Jeff — quick notes on the operational asks and availability: 

- 72-hour triage SLA: Redwood defines SLA in business hours (Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00 PT). For your ET team that maps to 11:00-21:00 ET. We'll commit to the 72-hour triage measured in business hours by default; we can extend to 24/7 for selected pilot customers (requires an addendum).

- Scan visibility: We do not expose a public dashboard for third-party customers currently, but we will provide weekly scan summaries (pdf) for the pilot window. We can also provide API access for customers on Dedicated or Private deployments.

- Evidence release & BAA: full pen test artifacts require a signed NDA and BAA if PHI is in scope. For planning purposes, we can produce the redacted summary now and place a hold on evidence release until legal executes the relevant docs. Typical legal turnaround 3–5 business days.

Proposed meeting times: Tue 9/14 13:00 PT / Wed 9/15 10:00 PT — we can do either; recommend 30 mins.

I'll queue up the weekly scan summary to start the week of 9/13 and will follow up with SOC 2 cover letter link (to share under NDA).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Security Partnerships (acting) — Redwood Inference
